preserved_failure.oracle: projected_REALIZE pair-order permutation is representation-only and must preserve certificate_id and acceptance

diagnosis: W10 correctly canonicalized projected_realize for certificate_id construction but later compared the submitted raw list order directly against W7's canonical projected_realize list. This accidentally made relation serialization order authoritative even though the frozen C0 transcript defines projected_realize as a mathematical set whose transcript sorts pairs.

normative_effect.required_w10_fix: Normalize and validate submitted projected_realize to the same sorted unique relation before comparing it with independently derived projected_realize. No other transported field or evidence-chain rule changes.

anti_repair: Do not weaken the positive representation oracle, alter the certificate ID transcript, or special-case the baseline. The same normalization rule must apply to all valid candidate certificates.
